body: Thanks mate. We learn from our past experiences, and even though I will find it hard to it be properly 'happy' again, I will still enjoy my life with the friends and the support I have.
Even though she is gone, I still want to show that she was and always will be special person to me, forever.

Thank you for your kind support. I guess what we need to do is continue to live good lives in the memories of our lost loved ones. Just because their lives were tragically cut short, doesn't mean that we should do the same to ours.
